probes.why: a path field is read-only until its Unlock button is clicked
the driver's pick (Spotify) is locked without a Spotify sign-in
the field upper-cases what is typed
language codes, a bad one is put back

also.#security-recovery-question: What was the name of your first pet?

noSave.why: the settings search box: it filters the page and saves nothing
a filter box over a list on the page: saves nothing (Enter in the genre box adds a genre, pinned by the genreWhitelist composite)
the log viewer: picks what is read (GET /api/logs/tail), nothing is saved
local state: which yt-dlp channel the status line and the Update button are for
a developer preview wired by the shell bundle from outside the page (not loaded here): saves nothing
picks which video quality profile is on screen: saves nothing
the Connections services switch (Music, Video): which side's tiles are shown, saves nothing
the media server row as a whole (a radiogroup): each server in it is a button, pinned by the activeServer composite and the buttons

unshownKeys._environment.windows: a fact about the server, not a setting: the tabs read it to pick default folders and the cookie browser list
unshownKeys._source_status.qobuz: a fact about the server, not a setting: which chain sources are not ready, read by the Sources tiles
unshownKeys.acoustid.require_verified: the Quality tab's switch (#acoustid-require-verified) saves and shows this through the active quality profile (/api/quality-profile), the payload key is only its starting value
unshownKeys.lossy_copy.enabled: saved and shown through the active quality profile (#lossy-copy-enabled posts /api/quality-profile/custom/<id>/update)
unshownKeys.lossy_copy.codec: saved and shown through the active quality profile (#lossy-copy-codec)
unshownKeys.lossy_copy.bitrate: saved and shown through the active quality profile (#lossy-copy-bitrate)
unshownKeys.lossy_copy.downsample_hires: saved and shown through the active quality profile (#downsample-hires)
unshownKeys.post_processing.audio_completeness_check: saved and shown through the active quality profile (#audio-completeness-check)
unshownKeys.image_cache.max_cache_mb: #imgcache-max-mb saves this key but shows GET /api/image-cache/status (max_bytes), not the payload
unshownKeys.image_cache.thumbnails: #imgcache-thumbnails saves this key but shows GET /api/image-cache/status (thumbnails), not the payload
unshownKeys.lastfm.session_key: never shown: the Last.fm card only reads whether it is set (authorized or not)
unshownKeys.logging.level: #log-level-select reads and writes /api/settings/log-level, not this key
unshownKeys.logging.path: shown read-only (#log-path-display), there is no control for it
unshownKeys.security.signup_request_limit: a legacy key: sign-ups follow the sign-up template under People > Templates since #2166, no Settings control reads or writes it
unshownKeys.security.signup_sides: a legacy key: sign-ups follow the sign-up template under People > Templates since #2166, no Settings control reads or writes it
unshownKeys.youtube.cookies_file: shown read-only as the name of the saved cookies file; the paste box (#youtube-cookies-paste) writes cookies_paste and is never filled from the payload
